August 04, 2026 · by None · BSDBashLinuxProgrammingTechUnix

When to use AI in your projects and when to avoid it.

Depends

Here's the awnsers you will need

YES:

  • Throwaway project
  • Assistance
  • Code fixing
  • Reviewing simple code
  • Small functions
  • Quick fixes
  • Website speed boost from existing code by optimizing it

NO:

  • Vibe coding
  • Large functions that are critical
  • Code to database functions, depending on models
